name: document-search
description: Semantic search over benefits documents — containerized app with ETL pipeline and PostgreSQL + pgvector

scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml -f docker-compose.etl-documents.yml -f docker-compose.etl-webcrawl.yml -f docker-compose.genai-search.yml up -d
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml -f docker-compose.etl-documents.yml -f docker-compose.etl-webcrawl.yml -f docker-compose.genai-search.yml down
scripts.dev:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml -f docker-compose.etl-documents.yml -f docker-compose.etl-webcrawl.yml -f docker-compose.genai-search.yml build --parallel
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml -f docker-compose.etl-documents.yml -f docker-compose.etl-webcrawl.yml -f docker-compose.genai-search.yml logs -f
scripts.dev:ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml -f docker-compose.etl-documents.yml -f docker-compose.etl-webcrawl.yml -f docker-compose.genai-search.yml ps
